text:
The straight course of imprisoned water

became circle and song in your ardors,

bread of rock, in your miller's dance,

my murmurs happy with your dawns.


Sun of ears of wheat, your turning lips,

lips of weeping, light heaviness,

silence your bitter spring,

dead moon in the weeping of flowers.


Today I look at you, rest of the road,

coin of abandoned memory

in the quiet nostalgia of the mill.


Sad Cyclops, the eye without a gaze

and the walking form without destiny,

pierced through the axis of the air.

translation.title: To the Millstone
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the millstone as circular song, dead moon, abandoned coin, and sad Cyclops.
